start_here: Say to your AI: "Watch the law behind my cited sources." It reads each law-source row of the library table you name, re-reads each source page, and opens a calendar task for each quoted sentence that changed.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: each check is a run, and each change is one calendar_tasks row written through the connection the wake names.
instructions: 1. Name the store connection and the library table in the wake input (connection, table); a niche_key narrows the watch to one niche, null watches all.
2. Switch on the weekly wake: switch on the wake for workflow:watch-the-law-for-each-niche weekly.
3. Each changed quote becomes one calendar_tasks row with status To do; read them with select id, title from calendar_tasks where title like 'Law changed:%'.
4. Fix the cited rows or the business pages they feed, then mark the task Done.

worked_examples.title: A weekly watch with no changed quote opens nothing
